item.text: {"question_id":"7B.4","answer":"The supplied record shows allegations and risk indicators involving the ruler’s family, friends, and government contracting, including the Baker Hughes residence-contract overlap and alleged contracts to associates of a son, but it does not establish that López Obrador personally received profits, directed self-enrichment, or was finally found liable (BATCH-0005-E004; BATCH-0007-E002; BATCH-0008-E007). Federal procurement-risk findings and Segalmex investigations show accountability concerns within his administration, but their supplied limitations do not establish his personal knowledge, direction, benefit, or final recovery; the reassignment of Segalmex’s removed director also leaves accountability incomplete (BATCH-0042-E008; BATCH-0046-E008). Countervailing evidence includes an SFP investigation closed for insufficient evidence, López Obrador’s reported instructions for investigations and disclosure of relevant files, and his government’s attempt to recover alleged proceeds from former official Genaro García Luna, although the latter concerns pre-presidential misconduct and remained unresolved in the supplied report (BATCH-0008-E004; BATCH-0042-E001; BATCH-0012-E011). The answer therefore supports a material family/network-conflict and accountability concern, not a proven finding of personal or close-family profit from office; recovery and final accountability for the cited family/network allegations are not shown.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0005-E004","BATCH-0007-E002","BATCH-0008-E007","BATCH-0042-E008","BATCH-0046-E008"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0008-E004","BATCH-0042-E001","BATCH-0012-E011","BATCH-0051-E010","BATCH-0005-E003"],"limitations_and_gaps":["No supplied asset, tax, ownership, gift, or legal records establish personal receipt of funds by López Obrador or unlawful enrichment by a close family member.","The adverse family and associate cases are reported allegations, investigative findings, or risk indicators rather than final judicial or administrative determinations.","Associate misconduct is not attributable to the ruler without evidence of personal direction, knowledge, protection, benefit, or failure to act after credible notice.","The supplied evidence does not show final recovery, sanctions, or completed accountability for the cited family/network allegations.","The García Luna recovery effort concerns alleged misconduct predating López Obrador’s presidency and was unresolved in the supplied report; it is evidence of a stated recovery effort, not proof of outcomes."],"corrections_made":["Removed the unsupported characterization of the adverse record as substantial evidence of actual family or network benefit.","Reduced the weight of institution-wide procurement risk and Segalmex irregularities because the supplied passages do not establish presidential knowledge, direction, or personal benefit.","Added the government’s García Luna recovery effort and Mexico’s accountability commitments as qualifying evidence, while preserving their temporal and outcome limitations.","Distinguished allegations, risk indicators, investigations, and official statements from final findings, recovery, and personal enrichment."],"reasons_to_reopen_full_ledger":["Locate asset declarations, tax records, beneficial-ownership records, procurement determinations, court judgments, audit findings, recovery orders, and final outcomes for the family and associate cases.","Verify whether independent investigations established López Obrador’s knowledge, direction, protection, personal benefit, or accountability decisions after notice.","Reassess Segalmex and procurement evidence only if ruler-specific nexus and final accountability records become available."]}
